page_title: ALA 0-1 GET | Alaves v Getafe 09/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Asier Villalibre (Alaves) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Isidro Diaz's book.
90+3' Getafe take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

90+2' Jon Guridi (Alaves) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the right post. His effort, however, is blocked by David Soria, who pulls off a stunning save! The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Alaves.
90+1' Alaves work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

85' David Soria (Getafe) obviously intended to delay the restart of play and the referee blows the whistle. The expression of the referee Isidro Diaz is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. David Soria (Getafe) is shown a yellow card.
83' Here comes a substitution. Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) is brought on as a substitute for Juanmi.
81' Ramon Terrats (Getafe) receives a yellow card for infringement. The referee blows his whistle for unsporting behaviour, with Ramon Terrats (Getafe) the culprit.
78' Jose Bordalas Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Juan Bernat will be replaced by Abdoulaye Keita (Getafe).
76' Substitution. Asier Villalibre (Alaves) in, Manu Sanchez out.
76' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) produces a cross from the resulting free kick far from the goal, but there's no one to really attack the ball and the goalkeeper gathers easily.
73' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 13:9.
72' The attendance is 16236.
70' Juanmi (Getafe) has tested the patience of referee Isidro Diaz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
67' Although Allan Nyom (Getafe) is just on the bench, Isidro Diaz has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
66' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
63' Eduardo Coudet has decided to substitute Ander Guevara and he is replaced by Jon Guridi (Alaves).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carlos Martin trots off the pitch and is replaced by Pau Cabanes (Alaves).
60' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
60' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) is caught off guard a bit when the ball lands at his feet, causing him to rush a first-time shot that is easily blocked by an opposition player. Alaves have a corner.
57' Getafe can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
56' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Getafe comes to nothing. Corner kick. Getafe will have an opportunity.

54' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Getafe, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
53' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Isidro Diaz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Getafe get a free kick.
52' A pass by Carlos Martin (Alaves) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
51' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
47' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
46' We are about to witness a substitution. Borja Mayoral (Getafe) is replacing Christantus Uche.
46' The whistle blows and Isidro Diaz starts the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' The resulting set piece from Getafe is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+3' Toni Martinez (Alaves) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45+3' Diego Rico (Getafe) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
45+1' The game is interrupted now, Diego Rico (Getafe) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45+1' Toni Martinez (Alaves) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+1' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' 0 - 1 Goal! Antonio Sivera gets a hand on the penalty from Mauro Arambarri (Getafe), but can't stop it from flying into the roof of the net.
44' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) is going to take the penalty!
42' Isidro Diaz shows a yellow card to Abdel Abqar (Alaves) for his blatant foul.
42' Dangerous play by Abdel Abqar (Alaves). Isidro Diaz blows his whistle for a foul. The referee makes a call and blows his whistle for an infringement. Getafe are awarded a penalty.
42' It seemed like Diego Rico (Getafe) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
41' Isidro Diaz blows for a foul after Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Getafe are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
41' Ander Guevara (Alaves) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! A free kick to Getafe.
40' Christantus Uche (Getafe) is given a yellow card.

39' Moussa Diarra (Alaves) was too forceful with his tackle and Isidro Diaz interrupted the game to signal a free kick. It's a free kick to Getafe, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
33' Alaves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

29' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) receives a pass on the edge of the box and attempts a lob as the keeper is off his line, but the effort crashes off the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
27' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. A free kick has been awarded to Getafe.

24' Christantus Uche (Getafe) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Isidro Diaz no option but to blow his whistle. Alaves win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
23' Alaves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

22' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the top right corner, but David Soria keeps it out with an amazing save. The ball goes out for a corner. Alaves can continue in their attacking effort.
22' The Alaves players are exchanging some short passes.
18' Omar Alderete (Getafe) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
17' Omar Alderete (Getafe) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
14' Ramon Terrats (Getafe) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
13' Handball by Abdel Abqar (Alaves). Getafe will take a free kick.
10' A cross from a corner kick by Alaves is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
9' Isidro Diaz couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Carlos Vicente (Alaves) and blew his whistle. Getafe have a free kick.
7' Christantus Uche (Getafe) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Alaves are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
3' Omar Alderete (Getafe) makes a strong challenge and Isidro Diaz blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Alaves.
1' The first half has just begun.
Alaves will kick-off.
Isidro Diaz will referee today's match.
